question: India has categorised its wetlands into how many categories?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Wetlands of India divided into eight categories:

 
 
• Human-made wetlands
 
• Lakes
 
• River Floodplains
 
• Ox-bow Lakes
 
• Marshes
 
• Estuaries
 
• Swamps
 
• Delta
